senses.gloss: f. (מָצָה) that which is squeezed out, remnant, drain, juice.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Keritot 5:1">Ker. V, 1</cite> <he>דם הת׳</he> the last blood oozing through the cut of a vein.

<cite ref="Keritot 22a:29-35">Ib. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>איזהו דם … יצא דם הת׳ מפני שהוא שותת</he> which is the blood … with which life escapes? That which gushes forth in a jet, to the exclusion of the last blood, because that runs gently.
<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 3:13">Tosef. Makhsh. III, 13</cite> <he>תַּמְצוּת בשר</he> meat-juice.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ת׳ כור תרקב שותה וכ׳</he> the juice (moisture or drippings) of a field of the capacity of a Kor of seed is enough to water a field of the capacity of a Tarḳab &c., v. <cite ref="K00399"><he>כּוּשׁ</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 10a">Taan. 10ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 10a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ארץ ישראל … וכל העולם כולו מת׳</he> Palestine is watered by rains, and the rest of the world by the drain (that remains in the clouds).
<cite ref="Taanit 10a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>כל העולם כולו מת׳ גן וכ׳</he> the whole world is watered by the drains of Eden; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:16:2">Y. Sot. IX, end, 24ᶜ</cite> he was called Ḳiṭṭunta (v. <cite ref="S00900"><he>קִיטּוּנְתָּא</he></cite>), because he was the drain (last and least) of the righteous and pious; Mish.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> Y. ed. (17) <he>תַּמְצוּתָן</he> (Mish. a. Babli ed. 49ᵃ <he>קטנותן</he>, <cite ref="S00802"><he>קטנתא</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>תַּמְצִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:1:4">Y. M. Kat. I, beg. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>מי ת׳</he> drippings of rain gathered in pools; expl. <he>פסקו גשמים וכ׳</he> when the rains have ceased, and the mountains are trickling (v. <cite ref="B01103"><he>בָּצַץ</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 1:13">Tosef. Mikv. I, 13</cite> <he>מי תמצית</he>.
